proposed_claim: Claim A: Quantifies dependence on intra-tumoral evidence using controlled region interventions.
closest_prior_art: Bissoto et al. (2019) on skin lesions; Zeiler & Fergus (2014) on ImageNet.
evidence_for_novelty: First rigorous quantification on brain MRI using patient-disjoint splits and matched contralateral placebos.
evidence_against_novelty: Lesion masking and occlusion sensitivity are well-established concepts.
permitted_wording: The study quantifies intra-tumoral feature dependence in a frozen brain MRI classifier under strict patient-disjoint splits.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming to be the first study ever to mask a tumor in medical imaging.

proposed_claim: Claim B: Compares tumour removal against a focal matched placebo intervention.
closest_prior_art: Bissoto et al. (2019) used random patches; no contralateral placebo in MRI.
evidence_for_novelty: First study in brain MRI classification to use an automated contralateral collision-shifted placebo mask to control for ablated pixel volume.
evidence_against_novelty: Contralateral controls are standard in neuroimaging lesion studies.
permitted_wording: We introduce a matched contralateral focal placebo intervention to control for non-specific tissue area loss.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming contralateral brain tissue is an exact anatomical equivalent in asymmetric brains.

proposed_claim: Claim C: Tests distant-context sensitivity while strictly preserving global intensity statistics.
closest_prior_art: Geirhos et al. (2020) on natural images; Xiao et al. (2021) background swap.
evidence_for_novelty: First neuroimaging study to demonstrate that distant context disruption causes classification collapse under 100% luminance/variance invariance.
evidence_against_novelty: Tile scrambling is an established method in natural vision.
permitted_wording: Distant spatial patch scrambling with strict luminance preservation causes severe classification collapse in frozen brain MRI models.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming the model relies specifically on skull-base coordinates rather than general cranial topography.

proposed_claim: Claim D: Examines margin-removal effects using both zero-fill and smooth inpainting.
closest_prior_art: Fong & Vedaldi (2017) in natural vision; Cheng et al. (2015) SVM ring partition.
evidence_for_novelty: First study to prove that apparent deep CNN perilesional margin reliance is an artifact of artificial boundary step-edge gradients.
evidence_against_novelty: Cheng used ring partitions; Fong showed zero-fill creates boundary artifacts.
permitted_wording: Smooth boundary inpainting reveals that perilesional margin reliance in zero-fill ablation is primarily a boundary discontinuity artifact.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming peritumoral brain tissue contains zero biological or clinical information.

proposed_claim: Claim E: Combines patient-grouped evaluation with paired cluster-bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
closest_prior_art: Vangala et al. (2026) for patient splits; Zech et al. (2018) for bootstrap.
evidence_for_novelty: Integrates 3-tier patient/duplicate grouping with synchronized cluster bootstrap across 14 matched intervention conditions.
evidence_against_novelty: Patient splits and cluster bootstrap are established statistical tools.
permitted_wording: We evaluate all spatial interventions using synchronized paired patient-cluster bootstrap on leakage-free patient splits.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming to have invented cluster bootstrap or patient-disjoint splitting.

proposed_claim: Claim F: Systematically audits intervention-induced artifacts and distribution shift.
evidence_for_novelty: Quantifies boundary step gradients across zero-fill, Gaussian feathering, and Navier-Stokes inpainting alongside high-frequency Sobel energy.
evidence_against_novelty: Artifact auditing is a recognized methodology in computer vision.
permitted_wording: We systematically measure boundary step gradients and Sobel energy to detect intervention-induced artifacts.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming to have eliminated all out-of-distribution artifacts in tile scrambling.

proposed_claim: Claim G: Provides evidence that a specific skull-base coordinate shortcut causes predictions.
closest_prior_art: None (proposed hypothesis based on pituitary misclassification).
evidence_for_novelty: Glioma misclassification shifts heavily to pituitary under distant scrambling.
evidence_against_novelty: Distant scrambling scrambled the entire brain simultaneously; tile seams confounded the result.
permitted_wording: Distant spatial scrambling causes severe misclassification into skull-base categories, but specific skull-base coordinate reliance remains unisolated.
prohibited_overclaim: Asserting that ResNet-50 classifies pituitary tumors via a skull-base shortcut.

proposed_claim: Claim H: Establishes the absence of biological peritumoral tissue reliance.
evidence_for_novelty: Navier-Stokes inpainting restores performance to baseline levels.
evidence_against_novelty: Inpainting synthesizes texture; neural network invariance does not prove biological absence in human tissue.
permitted_wording: The frozen neural network does not exploit perilesional parenchymal features for 2D classification.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming that peritumoral brain tissue lacks diagnostic pathology in clinical medicine.

proposed_claim: Claim I: Establishes causal biological mechanisms.
closest_prior_art: Castro et al. (2020) defines causal DAGs in imaging.
evidence_against_novelty: Castro et al. (2020) proved image ablations probe model associations, not biology.
permitted_wording: These interventions characterize empirical model representations and do not establish causal biological mechanisms.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming to have discovered a biological cause of brain tumors.

proposed_claim: Claim J: The complete experimental protocol is novel.
closest_prior_art: Synthesizes concepts from Cheng (2015), Fong (2017), Bissoto (2019), Geirhos (2020), Vangala (2026).
evidence_for_novelty: No prior study has combined matched placebos, boundary-controlled inpainting, luminance-preserved scrambling, and paired cluster bootstrap in brain MRI.
evidence_against_novelty: Every individual component has conceptual precedent in prior literature.
permitted_wording: We present an audited multi-control spatial intervention protocol unifying matched placebos, inpainting controls, and cluster bootstrap for brain MRI.
prohibited_overclaim: Claiming the framework is fundamentally revolutionary or unprecedented in all machine learning.
